'''Chris Crookston''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 10th at [[March 2000 Logan tournament]] on 18 March 2000, according to Matthew Jensen's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d366">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-20-logan-utah-3-18-2000d366/ logan-utah-3-18-2000], DeckTech (Matthew "MattJ" Jensen, 20 March 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-20-logan-utah-3-18-2000d366/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
